title: LowFrame
description: A survival minecraft server with an active community!
body:
# LowFrame

LowFrame is a survival Minecraft server focused on community, fair gameplay, and keeping Minecraft fun without turning everything into a cash grab.

The server is built around long-term survival, player interaction, building, exploration, and just enjoying the game with other people.

## What LowFrame offers

- Community-focused survival
- No pay-to-win features
- Fair gameplay for everyone
- Java & Bedrock support
- Active development and updates
- Quality-of-life features without ruining vanilla survival
- Friendly playerbase and staff
- Long-term worlds and progression

## No Pay-to-Win

LowFrame does not sell overpowered ranks, unfair kits, or gameplay advantages.

Everyone plays on equal ground.

## Server Info

### Java Edition

```
play.mc-lowframe.org
```


### Bedrock Edition

```
play.mc-lowframe.org
```
Port:

```
8045
```

## Join LowFrame

Whether you want to build, grind survival, make a town, or just hang out, LowFrame is made to feel like an actual community instead of another generic survival server.
